milestones.title: Q01 — Thread — Local contract
milestones.focus: Make exact local-text recovery operational from explicit selection through evidence opening.
milestones.exit_criteria: Public repository, canonical schema, explicit text ingest, exact lexical evidence, desktop flow, benchmark, and CI are operational.

milestones.title: Q02 — Hem — Durable indexing
milestones.focus: Make the local index recoverable, revocable, observable, and repairable.
milestones.exit_criteria: Crash recovery, reconciliation, schema compatibility, revocable scopes, cancellation, and FTS repair converge without stale searchable sources.

milestones.title: Q03 — Needle — Multimodal extraction
milestones.focus: Add deterministic PDF and image extraction with exact spatial evidence.
milestones.exit_criteria: PDF/OCR extraction, page and region anchors, the evidence viewer, and the rebuildable semantic-index contract are deterministic.

milestones.title: Q04 — Lens — Evaluated retrieval
milestones.focus: Measure hybrid retrieval quality, accessibility, and resource behavior across supported media.
milestones.exit_criteria: Filters, multimodal evaluation, accessibility, screenshot capture, adversarial fixtures, confidence states, and 100k-scale budgets are measured.

milestones.title: Q05 — Pattern — Intentional capture
milestones.focus: Define a least-privilege browser capture boundary with visible snapshot truth.
milestones.exit_criteria: Browser capture is explicit-save, least-privilege, provenance-aware, and distinguishes live URLs from best-effort snapshots.

milestones.title: Q06 — Shuttle — Provenance alpha
milestones.focus: Prove portable provenance and capture controls with design partners.
milestones.exit_criteria: Export and backup round trips, provenance compaction, connector replay, retention controls, and privacy-safe alpha evidence pass their declared gates.

milestones.title: Q07 — Weave — Daily-driver core
milestones.focus: Turn the local retrieval core into a durable, recoverable daily-driver candidate.
milestones.exit_criteria: Durable jobs, deduplication, recovery, SDK boundaries, private ranking, and signed release inputs meet resource and integrity gates.

milestones.title: Q08 — Loom — Release readiness
milestones.focus: Earn a supported macOS release through quality, security, restore, and adoption evidence.
milestones.exit_criteria: Independent review, the v1 quality and value gate, read-only API, Mac integrations, lineage explanations, restore drills, and signed artifacts pass.

milestones.title: Q09 — Tapestry — Private continuity
milestones.focus: Specify optional private continuity without weakening the complete local product.
milestones.exit_criteria: E2EE protocol, device identity, conflict semantics, mobile capture, and local model isolation are reviewed and recoverable while local-only mode remains complete.

milestones.title: Q10 — Bobbin — Gated experiments
milestones.focus: Test connectors, bounded capture, and obligation workflows before committing to expansion.
milestones.exit_criteria: Professional connectors and bounded-capture and obligation experiments produce explicit continue, narrow, or stop decisions with cost and privacy evidence.

milestones.title: Q11 — Fabric — Platform boundaries
milestones.focus: Define portable platform, collection, and extension boundaries.
milestones.exit_criteria: Platform parity, shared-collection consent, extension trust, and compatibility evidence are published with unsupported states visible.

milestones.title: Q12 — Selvage — Public evidence
milestones.focus: Publish evidence for synthesis, professional workflows, adoption, and the next strategy gate.
milestones.exit_criteria: Synthesis anchors or abstains; provenance views, professional-mode research, benchmark and HCI artifacts, economics, and strategy decisions are complete.

milestones.title: Q13 — Atlas — Portability
milestones.focus: Make libraries portable across devices, platforms, and storage failures.
milestones.exit_criteria: Interchange, source identity, encrypted backup, sync observability, multilingual coverage, private ranking, migration, and offline packaging pass.

milestones.title: Q14 — Observatory — Temporal evidence
milestones.focus: Make time, change, and uncertainty inspectable without inventing history.
milestones.exit_criteria: Temporal provenance, snapshots, explanations, evaluation, multilingual ranking, calibration, correction, and privacy-safe diagnostics pass.

milestones.title: Q15 — Commons — Interoperability
milestones.focus: Open a constrained ecosystem around portable evidence and reproducible evaluation.
milestones.exit_criteria: Public interchange, extension containment, connector conformance, benchmark v2, red-team governance, provenance preservation, and release governance pass.

milestones.title: Q16 — Relay — Optional transport
milestones.focus: Admit transport only if demand and threat-model gates justify it.
milestones.exit_criteria: Authority, rendezvous, metering, key rotation, conflict inspection, restore, endpoint threat model, and lifecycle tests pass; a stop decision remains valid.

milestones.title: Q17 — Stewardship — Professional assurance
milestones.focus: Bound professional retention, audit, integrity, and incident controls without forensic claims.
milestones.exit_criteria: Retention and legal-hold policy, privacy profiles, audit export, access review, integrity proofs, sealed workspaces, incident response, and assurance review pass.

milestones.title: Q18 — Horizon — Robust retrieval research
milestones.focus: Measure retrieval robustness, uncertainty, efficiency, and human factors under realistic shifts.
milestones.exit_criteria: Distribution shift, cross-language alignment, uncertainty UX, citation graphs, model budgets, privacy-safe learning, the longitudinal study, and reproducibility pass.

milestones.title: Q19 — Field Study — Five-year retrospective
milestones.focus: Audit architecture, support, sustainability, governance, and interoperability before the final decision.
milestones.exit_criteria: Architecture, support, compute and storage cost, maintainership, and standards retrospectives produce an evidence-backed draft decision.

milestones.title: Q20 — Five-Year Review — Sustainability
milestones.focus: Choose a sustainable future for every LOOM workstream and publish the evidence.
milestones.exit_criteria: Market and research value, willingness to adopt, funding, stewardship, benchmark evidence, and the final continue, narrow, archive, or fork decision are published.
